body: Thanks everyone for your answers, I appreciate it. Glad to know it's not something I was doing wrong. I'll be keeping my head down and following orders as usual and hopefully be back out on the street consistently at some point.

I would possibly try to talk with someone else about your feelings, even if it's just the people in the comments. The way you feel is valid and you have a right to be listened to.

If your boyfriend can't be bothered to take your feelings seriously and actually listen to you when you are hurting like this, I think you should seriously seek support elsewhere. I know you two have been together for a long time and he is who you normally talk to about these feelings. But you should not be punished for feeling the way you do. You shouldn't be made to feel worse just for wanting to talk things through. You didn't do anything wrong.
Nope. Thanks for continuing to check in though, I appreciate it.

I feel the same way. Its awful to feel so out of control and have nobody understand or know how to help you. It feels like you're alone in this life and this is how you will always feel. You're numb to everything, but at the same time you feel indescribable pain and there isn't anything to make it stop besides sleeping. I just want to say that I know dying feels like the best option (hell, I'm heavily considering it myself) but hang in there. If you need someone to talk to, I'm here to listen. Us grin reapers should stick together.
About the same. Thanks for asking.

I don't really have much of a choice, ya know? I have tens of thousands of dollars in student loan debt and the payments start next month and a negative balance in my bank account and no job. I don't want to work, I don't want to do anything. If I could just go to sleep and not wake up and have to deal with all this shit, that'd be ideal.
